messages.subject: Question on Vector Cross Product Problem 4
messages.content: Assalamu Alaikum Ma’am, in today’s problem 4 from sheet 1, do we need to calculate the unit vector perpendicular to both vectors using the right-hand screw rule or the determinant method?

messages.subject: Re: Question on Vector Cross Product Problem 4
messages.content: Wa Alaikum Assalam Rahim. You should use the matrix determinant method to find (A x B), and then divide by its magnitude |A x B| to get the unit normal vector. The right-hand screw rule is only for physical direction verification.

messages.subject: Upcoming Calculus Class Test Format
messages.content: Sir, will Class Test 1 include L’Hospital’s rule proofs, or only application problems?

messages.subject: Re: Upcoming Calculus Class Test Format
messages.content: Only standard limit evaluations and direct application of L’Hospital’s rule for indeterminate forms 0/0 and inf/inf. No theoretical epsilon-delta proofs will be in CT 1.
